text: Electrical control and interlock philosophy is in ALP-EPC-00000-EL-RPT-0001: breakers of the 380 kV and 21 / 15.75 kV are controlled from the DCS with hardwired interlocks in the bay controllers; local control at the switchgear has priority through a local / remote selector; MV / LV boards are supervised by the DCS via IEC 61850 (MV) and Modbus TCP (LV smart devices).
